summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the previous framework-only adjudication failure for doi__10.1371_journal.pone.0048721. XML Table 1 supports 24 DHBV-release IC50 activity rows for the linked DBAASP peptides, Figure/text support qualitative non-cytotoxicity for Deca-(Arg)8, and mechanism evidence supports a late morphogenesis/enveloped-particle release block. Remaining database concerns are preserved as caution-level source_conflict rows, not hidden or promoted to clean verification.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary text and Figure 1C support no statistically significant cytotoxicity at 1-4 μM; exact 15%/10% killing values are not in XML/PDF text/table and are preserved as database conflict.
CAMP linked rows include truncated titles and aggregate activity text without recoverable sequence/name fields in local packet or targeted merged output search.
Supplementary S1/S2 are local TIF figures with XML captions; no recoverable supplementary tables or spreadsheets were present, so exact plotted values were not fabricated.
